title: Chris Ramsay's own associative remote viewing training and results, which led to the Area 52 channel

tellings.quote: um we start getting really crazy results, like good results.

plain: In 2023 the YouTuber Chris Ramsay trained in associative remote viewing, a practice of trying to sense with the mind a picture linked to an outcome that is not yet known, and he says the results were "really crazy," "like good results." Ramsay tells it himself and says this is what led him to start his Area 52 channel. To him it suggests the practice works.
